pair_actuator_instructions.description: Put the module into pairing mode now (for example, on a Ubiwizz press PRESS briefly three times; its LED flashes). Then continue to start the {timeout}-second pairing window.

pair_actuator_failure.title: Pairing timed out
pair_actuator_failure.description: No confirmation was received before the 120-second window ended. The device is already saved.

device_form.title: Name the captured device

data_description.manual_eep: Leave empty to keep the profile unknown. Format XX-XX-XX, e.g. A5-12-01. A typed profile is recorded as an operator assertion, never as proof.

import_yaml.title: Import YAML devices
import_yaml.description:
Ready to import: {binary_sensors} binary sensors and {switches} switches. {non_importable} devices use unsupported YAML platforms and will remain in YAML; {invalid} invalid or partial rows will be ignored.

Do not remove YAML before importing. After importing, remove the imported YAML blocks, restart Home Assistant, and verify the entities. Entity IDs and automations are preserved.

data.confirm: I understand and want to import

import_yaml_success.title: YAML devices imported
import_yaml_success.description:
Imported: {imported}. Skipped as duplicates: {skipped}.

Now remove the imported YAML blocks, restart Home Assistant, and verify the entities and automations.

delete_confirm.title: Remove device?
delete_confirm.description: Remove {name} ({platform}, {captured_id})? This also deletes its entity registry entry.

progress.waiting_for_device: Press the button on the device now. Waiting up to 60 seconds for an unknown EnOcean sender.
progress.pairing_actuator: Pairing in progress for up to {timeout} seconds. Commands are sent repeatedly; keep the module in pairing mode.

error.unique_id_exists: A device with this identity already exists. Teach-in never merges or overwrites an existing device.
error.invalid_channel_rps: RPS switches only support channel 0 or 1.
error.invalid_channel: Channel must be an exact integer between 0 and 255.
error.invalid_sender_id: Sender ID must be 4 hex bytes, e.g. 05:9F:89:34.
error.invalid_qr_code: The value is neither a supported EnOcean Alliance commissioning QR payload nor an ID formatted as AA:BB:CC:DD.
error.invalid_exact_integer: Value must be an exact integer within the displayed bounds.
error.invalid_number: Value must be a finite number within the displayed bounds.
error.invalid_temperature_range: Minimum temperature must be lower than maximum temperature.
error.invalid_raw_range: Raw range start and end must differ.
error.invalid_command_frequency: Command frequency must be a valid positive duration of at least one second.
error.invalid_eep: The manual EEP must use the exact XX-XX-XX hexadecimal format, e.g. A5-12-01.

abort.learn_timeout: No unknown EnOcean sender was heard before the timeout.
abort.learn_in_progress: A teach-in window is already in progress.
abort.device_form_missing: The device form session expired; start again.
abort.yaml_managed: This EnOcean ID is also configured in YAML. Remove the YAML configuration before deleting its UI device.
abort.no_yaml_devices_to_import: No YAML devices remain to import.
abort.yaml_import_cancelled: YAML import cancelled. No devices were changed.

learn.name: Start EnOcean teach-in

reload.description: Reload YAML-configured EnOcean platforms from the current configuration.

serial_communicator_stopped.title: The EnOcean serial worker stopped
serial_communicator_stopped.description: The serial worker for {device} is no longer running: {reason}. EnOcean entities are unavailable and outgoing commands are rejected to prevent a second process from competing for the port. Check the USB connection and logs, then reload the integration or restart Home Assistant once.
